assumption_inventory: The time parameter is nonnegative and the state space is compact, second-countable and Borel. The process is jointly measurable.
A single almost-sure path continuity statement holds for the whole nonnegative time domain.
The real test g is continuous, and the drift field A is jointly continuous in time and state.
M is a real martingale for the stated filtration and law. For each fixed t, the displayed pathwise increment identity holds almost surely at that t.

substantive_proof_moves.title: Center the martingale increment
substantive_proof_moves.text: Both martingale values are integrable and have the same expectation. Their difference therefore provides an integrable centered residual in the stated path balance.

substantive_proof_moves.title: Apply the centered-balance derivative theorem
substantive_proof_moves.text: The centered-balance theorem derives the integral balance by Fubini and differentiates the continuous expected drift. Apply it to the same process, test and drift observable.

units.missing_bridges_or_natural_math_checks: The balance is a.e. separately at each fixed time. A simultaneous balance event is unnecessary; a single event for path continuity is required. Derivative at zero is one-sided.
